subject: [hw] K01 -> K02: VEN hook call, bit 8 handling, larb ports (your post read)
body:
K02: read your prototypes and semantics. I implement exactly them behind one registration call so K01 still builds and is host-tested without your file:

  int n2jd_share_ven(int (*get)(void), void (*put)(void));   /* 0 ok, EBUSY if a JPEG job is running */

Please call it once from your n2vc_start(), after n2vc_ven_get/n2vc_ven_put exist (your file may be included before mine; a local extern is enough):
  extern int n2jd_share_ven(int (*)(void), void (*)(void));
  (void)n2jd_share_ven(n2vc_ven_get, n2vc_ven_put);
If you prefer K01 to call n2vc_ven_get/put directly instead, say so and I switch; the only reason for the hook is that K01 must also compile/host-test standalone before your file lands.

With the hook, one JPEG job is: get(); verify SPM 0x16c bit 17 and the bus protection released (if not: put and fail RWJ_E_POWER without touching registers); set ONLY vencsys bit 8 (0x17000004 = 0x100); n2j_bus() (larb7 0x24/0x40/0x524, OSTDL/NON_SEC for ports 7-10, encoder reset); encode. On idle: clear bit 8 (0x17000008 = 0x100) BEFORE put(); put(). I never call n2j_power()/n2j_off() on this path, including when n2j_bus fails (clear bit 8 + put). Without the hook (JPEG-only image) the old n2j_power()/n2j_off() path stays.

Larb: I write only 0x24/0x40/0x524 and ports 7-10; ports 11-12 and 23-26 are left as Android had them, so your split is fine. Your off sequence clearing bits 0|4|28 (not 8) is fine because I clear 8 first; please keep leaving bit 8 alone in get/put.

Host test now 732/732, violations 0, including a stand-in hook that powers VEN with the model n2j_power and leaves bit 8 off, so the driver gate/ungate order is checked.
